intro.data: The do-nothing step works on the other side too. Run the Parser, then pass the result through Pass Through — the goal is unchanged.
intro.alchemy: The do-nothing step works on the other side too. Run the Smelter, then pass the result through Preserve — the goal is unchanged.
intro.spellcraft: The do-nothing step works on the other side too. Cast Ignition, then pass the result through Echo — the goal is unchanged.
intro.abstract: Identity works on the other side too. Apply f, then id_B — the goal is unchanged.

goal.data: Wire the start through the Parser and then Pass Through to reach the goal.
goal.alchemy: Wire the start through the Smelter and then Preserve to reach the goal.
goal.spellcraft: Wire the start through Ignition and then Echo to reach the goal.
goal.abstract: Wire the start through f and then id_B to reach the goal.

afterSuccess.data: Adding a do-nothing step after the Parser changed nothing. An identity step is neutral on either side of a process.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Adding a do-nothing step after the Smelter changed nothing. An identity step is neutral on either side of a process.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Adding a do-nothing step after Ignition changed nothing. An identity step is neutral on either side of a working.
afterSuccess.abstract: Adding identity after f changed nothing. An identity step is neutral on either side of a morphism.

reveal.summary: The other half of the identity law: putting an identity step after a process also leaves it unchanged. id_B ∘ f is just f.
reveal.moreFormal: Identity morphisms are two-sided units for composition: for any f : A → B, both id_B ∘ f = f and f ∘ id_A = f.
